summary.name: BarTranslate
summary.one_liner: A Mac menu bar app that gives quick access to a simplified Google Translate view via a hotkey.
use_cases: quick translation without leaving current app
looking up words while writing or reading on a Mac
accessing Google Translate from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: BarTranslate places a simplified Google Translate interface in the Mac menu bar. A configurable hotkey toggles the window from anywhere, and the source text field is autofocused when it opens. A Quick Translate hotkey translates whatever is on the clipboard immediately. It offers System, Light, or Dark appearance settings and remembers the last-used source and target languages. The translation is rendered through an altered webview of Google Translate.
notable: Quick Translate hotkey that translates clipboard contents instantly
Configurable global hotkey with autofocus on the source field
Free and open source, with an optional small App Store fee that includes automatic updates
caveats: Translations depend on an altered webview of Google Translate, so it relies on Google's service
Automatic updates and project support come through a small App Store fee
